description: Gold-labelled evaluation cases. Expected priorities follow the triage guidance the rules are adapted from (MTS, ESI, WHO ETAT/IMCI, NEWS2), set from case content, not from system output. split=holdout is held-out set 2, written on 2026-10-22 before the model-pipeline fixes and never used for tuning; the earlier held-out set 1 (ho01-ho20) became development data after its misses were used for diagnosis.
